items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is a short block that matches the surrounding style. It has a clear comment: '# parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth / so we'll add it ourselves.'

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It is a minimal 4-line edit to prepend_scheme_if_needed that reuses parse_url's auth field. It adds no helpers, leaves no dead code or debug output, and is identical to the reference fix.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The 'if auth:' guard leaves URLs without credentials unchanged. Credentials go back on exactly as parsed, with no re-encoding. No exception handling is needed and there are no magic constants. All hidden tests pass.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged, and auth is only re-attached when present, via netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc]). Nothing special-cases urllib3 or the Python version. The fix matches the reference, and the 185 P2P tests pass.
